issue: The original validation index list is class-contiguous, while gradient probes used its first 16 indices and Jacobian probes used the first 8 of those indices; all original probes therefore have label 0.
authorized_scope: Load the 60 saved v2 checkpoint weights without training and repeat the existing metric definitions on label-balanced probes from the persisted 2,000-image validation subset.

probe_selection.algorithm: For each label 0 through 9, filter the persisted validation indices in manifest order, apply a seeded torch.randperm to that label's candidates, and take the first four. Preserve label-major order in the output.
probe_selection.jacobian_subset_rule: Use the first two selected gradient probes for each label.

gradient_measurements: All 12 depth/seed runs at checkpoints 0,25,100,300,600; definitions unchanged from v2.
jacobian_measurements: Depths 3,12,24 at checkpoints 0,100,600 for all seeds; 20 balanced probes and the same representative layers and metric definitions as v2.

numerical_change_flags.definition: Gradient rows are flagged when absolute mean per-probe raw-gap or slope delta is at least 0.05. Jacobian fields are flagged when |new-old|/max(|old|,|new|,1e-12) is at least 0.20.

stop_conditions: Stop before measurement unless histograms are exactly four and two probes per label.
Stop if any selected probe overlaps the training subset or leaves the persisted validation subset.
Stop if any of 60 checkpoint files is absent or fails its recorded SHA-256 hash.
Never instantiate an optimizer or execute a training step.
Never overwrite the v2 source run or an existing post-hoc output directory.
interpretation_limit: These measurements are post-hoc exploratory corrections of probe coverage, not preregistered v2 evidence and not a new training experiment.
ai_assistance: AI implemented and executed the bounded read-only weight remeasurement; the researcher retains interpretation and claim ownership.
